probe.text_sample: Your Page Title aubergine projects menu aubergine close Services Projects Garden care About Areas Journal Free quote Overview +34 960 000 000 [email protected] Camí de Vera 18, 46022 Valencia A garden company from Valencia, planting for the climate it has Founded 2011, in Valencia Gardens planted 340 Team 22 people, two crews for care Yard Camí de Vera 18, Valencia Joan Ribera grew up building dry stone walls with his father in Sagunto. Ingrid Halvorsen came from Bergen to study the gardens of the Alhambra and stayed. They met on a terrace in Altea in 2009, rebuilding a garden that had been planted like a lawn in England and was dying every August. Two years later they started Aubergine with one van and a simple idea: gardens on this coast should be planted for the sun, the wind and the water they actually get. Today the company designs, builds and looks after gardens from Sagunto to Dénia. Most of the people who built the first gardens still work here, and many of those gardens are still in our care.
